decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PF9500 Bi-Folding Speed Gate; received 03/08/2018. 18-01078_SLP01, TAS/5, PF4000 Full Height Single Turnstile, Rapleys Planning Statement, Flood Risk Assessment and Drainage Strategy, Preliminary Risk Assessment (July 2018), Tamlor Lighting Assessment, Iceni Transport Statement (July 2018), Redmore Environmental Air Quality Assessment (17th July 2018); received 10/08/2018. Car Park Management Plan (October 2018), Active Electric Vehicle Charging Specification, 0000-04-04-Rev A & Transport Note (18/10/2018), Tascor Yard, Heston & Air Links - Technical Note, Greenfield Runoff Estimations, Greenfield Runoff Volume, ICP SUDS Mean Annual Flood; received 19/10/2018. 0000-06-06 REV A, 0000-08-08 REV A & Ancillary Facilities images; received 12/11/2018.
) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No building hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, prior to the first use of the development hereby permitted full details (including manufacturers specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than 8 bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and the cycle parking facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development and retained for use at all times thereafter without obstruction.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, prior to the first use of the development hereby approved, full details of electric vehicle parking provision (for not less than 16 active spaces and 3 passive spaces) and management shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall conform with the requirements stipulated within the London Plan and the electric vehicle charging points shall be provided in accordance with approved details before the first occupation of the development and maintained as such at all times thereafter.
Condition : 6 - No vehicle larger than a twelve metre rigid lorry shall enter the site.
description: Use of the site as vehicle/lorry parking (Sui Generis) and associated alterations following clearance of existing structures, including the formation of new access, the replacement of hardstanding, the installation of a new gate/turnstile and fence, the provision of lighting and ancillary site facilities, including vehicle maintenance and staff facilities
